name: receipts
description: Show me the receipts: AI checking AI for Claude Code on a weaker model such as DeepSeek. Rules on what the model ran catch circles, bent tests and claims the record contradicts; a second, stronger model runs its claims and reviews its changes; what does not hold goes back to the model before the turn ends

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: The model that checks the work: runs the claims and reviews the change. Default `opus`, which DeepSeek's endpoint serves with its Pro model while `sonnet` and `haiku` get Flash. Any model id your endpoint takes, e.g. deepseek-v4-pro. If the endpoint refuses it, `sonnet` is used.

review_changes.title: Review each turn's change
review_changes.description: At the end of a turn that changed code, the verifier also reads the change for a defect a command can show.
